name: Review commands
description: Slash commands that expand to review prompts, a shared review skill and a picker panel.

slashCommands.name: review
slashCommands.prompt: Review the uncommitted changes in this project. List real bugs first, with file and line, then risky spots. Do not change any files.

slashCommands.name: explain
slashCommands.description: Explain this project to a newcomer
slashCommands.prompt: Explain how this project is organised for someone new to it: the main folders, how a request flows through the code, and where to start reading.

slashCommands.name: tests-first
slashCommands.description: Write the failing test before the fix
slashCommands.prompt: Before fixing anything, write a test that reproduces the problem and show me that it fails. Then make the smallest fix that makes it pass.
